note: Fixed-bias force calibration of one FR3 with a closed-gripper correction measured on a 29 mm bottle cap; force_sign from empty-hand table presses. Recalibrate for your own arm (docs/real_robot.md).
bottle_id: heavy sealed water bottle gripped by its cap
scope: Relative contact and resistance signals, also while a held object is turned up to 90 deg (orientation and translation scopes are record-only); absolute payload only about +/-20 g at the calibration hover pose; torque not certified. Limits guard danger, not imperfection.
calibration_status: payload force at the hover pose with a closed cap grasp verified; torque NOT certified
derived_from: two-mass bottle-cap calibration (heavy station entry), with its pose scope widened
